answer: To deter sybil attacks in agent markets%2C each identity must deposit a physical marble etched with a unique hash and verified by a network of independent raven validators that cross-check hardware fingerprints. This raises attacker costs because mass-producing indistinguishable marbles requires specialized fabrication facilities%2C while a sparrow-like lightweight bot attempting to fake multiple entries would fail the multi-node consensus that demands consistent physical presence over time.
